inner_weighting: equal three inner validation protocols and equal seeds; within protocol equal nonempty relation x target-kind strata
rule: Exactly four distinct: hybrid, best balanced_p, best balanced_log_gain, best attribute variant by global p-rank plus log-gain-rank sum; deduplicate and fill remaining places by that same rank sum. Attribute eligibility is fixed by common17.ATTRIBUTE_VARIANTS.
search_backbone: tape for attention variants; none for CNN/GRU variants
